acme-prod-analytics-service-0000
triggers.user_data:
#cloud-config
package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: analytics-service
        environment: prod
        region: us-east-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/analytics-service:latest

#cloud-config
package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: auth-service
        environment: prod
        region: eu-west-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/auth-service:latest

#cloud-config
package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: catalog-service
        environment: prod
        region: ap-south-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/catalog-service:latest

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: notification-svc
        environment: prod
        region: eu-west-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/notification-svc:latest

package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: order-service
        environment: prod
        region: us-west-2
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/order-service:latest

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: order-service
        environment: prod
        region: us-east-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/order-service:latest

#cloud-config
package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: order-service
        environment: prod
        region: us-east-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/order-service:latest

#cloud-config
package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: payment-service
        environment: prod
        region: ap-south-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/payment-service:latest

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: reporting-service
        environment: prod
        region: ap-south-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/reporting-service:latest

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: search-service
        environment: prod
        region: eu-west-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/search-service:latest

#cloud-config
package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: search-service
        environment: prod
        region: eu-west-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/search-service:latest

#cloud-config
package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: shipping-service
        environment: prod
        region: us-west-2
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/shipping-service:latest

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: user-service
        environment: prod
        region: us-east-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/user-service:latest

package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: analytics-service
        environment: prod
        region: ap-south-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/analytics-service:latest

#cloud-config
package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: analytics-service
        environment: prod
        region: us-east-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/analytics-service:latest

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: auth-service
        environment: prod
        region: eu-west-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/auth-service:latest

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: catalog-service
        environment: prod
        region: us-east-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/catalog-service:latest

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: catalog-service
        environment: prod
        region: ap-south-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/catalog-service:latest

#cloud-config
package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: catalog-service
        environment: prod
        region: ap-south-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/catalog-service:latest

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: fraud-detection
        environment: prod
        region: us-west-2
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/fraud-detection:latest

package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: order-service
        environment: prod
        region: us-west-2
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/order-service:latest

#cloud-config
package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: order-service
        environment: prod
        region: us-west-2
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/order-service:latest

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: payment-service
        environment: prod
        region: us-west-2
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/payment-service:latest

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: recommendation-svc
        environment: prod
        region: us-east-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/recommendation-svc:latest

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: reporting-service
        environment: prod
        region: us-east-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/reporting-service:latest

#cloud-config
package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: search-service
        environment: prod
        region: ap-south-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/search-service:latest

package_update: true
package_upgrade: true
packages:
  - docker.io
  - awscli
  - jq
  - curl
  - unzip
  - chrony
  - amazon-cloudwatch-agent
write_files:
  - path: /etc/app/config.yaml
    permissions: '0644'
    content: |
      service:
        name: user-service
        environment: prod
        region: ap-south-1
        log_level: info
        metrics:
          enabled: true
          interval_seconds: 15
          endpoint: https://metrics.internal.acme.io/ingest
        tracing:
          enabled: true
          sampler_ratio: 0.1
          collector: otel-collector.observability.svc.cluster.local:4317
        feature_flags:
          enable_circuit_breaker: true
          enable_retry_budget: true
          max_retries: 3
          retry_backoff_ms: 200
        database:
          pool_size: 20
          connection_timeout_ms: 5000
          statement_timeout_ms: 30000
runcmd:
  - systemctl enable docker
  - systemctl start docker
  - docker run -d --restart=always --name app -p 8080:8080 registry.internal.acme.io/user-service:latest
